title: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 Manila Leg 3 Review: What the Race Was Like
seo_title: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Manila Leg 3 2026 Review | Pasay
meta_description: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 Manila Leg 3 review: a 32K at SM Mall of Asia on 6 September, run in torrential rain and won on a shared time.
dek: The closing leg of the Manila trilogy is a 32 km from the SM Mall of Asia grounds. The 2026 edition, on 6 September, was run in torrential rain. Here is what it was like, from the report on it.
verdict: Manila Leg 3 is the long race of RunRio's Manila trilogy: a 32 km from the SM Mall of Asia grounds in Pasay, with 21 km, 10 km and shorter races alongside [1]. The 2026 edition, on Sunday 6 September, was run in torrential rain [1]. Ricky Organiza won the men's 32 km in 1:53:14 on the same time as Kenya's Gilbert Muge, and Pamela Chepkoech Bundotich won the women's in 2:13:20 [1]. If you want a supported long run in Metro Manila with a genuinely fast front of the field, this is one. In the September rainy season, bring gear for the weather.

sections.heading: The 2026 Manila Leg 3
paragraphs: The race was run on Sunday 6 September 2026 at the SM Mall of Asia grounds in Pasay, with RunRio as organiser and Sante Barley as title sponsor [1]. The runners raced through torrential rain [1].
The 32 km is the centrepiece, with 21 km and 10 km races on the same morning [1]. Earlier in the Manila series, Leg 1 featured a 16 km [1].

sections.heading: A Photo Finish at the Front
paragraphs: Ricky Organiza won the men's 32 km in 1:53:14, credited with the same time as Kenya's Gilbert Muge in second, with Edsel Moral third in 1:55:44 [1]. Organiza had finished third in the 16 km at Leg 1 [1]. Pamela Chepkoech Bundotich of Kenya won the women's 32 km in 2:13:20, ahead of Jessa Mae Roda (2:15:23) and Purity Serem (2:15:51) [1].

In the 21 km, Ritchie Estampador won by a second from James Kevin Cruz in 1:21:09, and Edna Magtubo won the women's race in 1:32:04 by more than 18 minutes [1]. Friz Angelo Operio won the men's 10 km in 32:15 [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you are building towards a marathon in Metro Manila, yes. A timed, supported 32 km is a useful step before a marathon, and the trilogy format gives you a season of racing leading up to it.
Plan for the weather. The 2026 race was run in torrential rain [1], and early September is in the rainy season around Manila Bay.
This review is compiled from a published race report on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: What distances does Manila Leg 3 offer?
faqs.answer: The 32 km centrepiece, plus a 21 km and a 10 km, all from the SM Mall of Asia grounds in Pasay. It is the longest race of the Manila trilogy, which starts with shorter distances earlier in the year.

faqs.question: What was the weather like at Manila Leg 3 in 2026?
faqs.answer: Wet. The Daily Tribune reported that the runners braved torrential rainfall on Sunday 6 September 2026. Early September falls in the rainy season around Manila Bay, so plan for rain.
